title: retry_charge, then the invoice
question: what happens when the gateway drops the call
author: claude-code

stops.text: retry_charge asks the gateway to charge an order and tries again when the call is dropped, up to `attempts` times, before it gives up with a ChargeError.

blocks.title: Try, then give up
blocks.text: The loop makes up to `attempts` tries. The first one that does not drop returns its answer; when all of them drop, the error names the order.

blocks.title: A dropped call tries again
blocks.text: Only a *ConnectionError* counts as a dropped call: it moves on to the next try. Any other error leaves the loop at once.

stops.text: Invoice.total adds the amounts of the invoice lines and has the tax applied for the invoice's country. It is what the customer is charged.
apply_tax raises an amount by the country's rate and rounds it to cents, so the total on the invoice is the amount that is charged.
